metadata.name: Flatpack Depot
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A huge flat-pack furniture superstore. The Showroom team starts upstairs on the one-way path winding through 35 furnished room sets (living rooms, kitchens, bedrooms, home offices, kids' bunk rooms, bathrooms, dining rooms) with shortcut doors and low partitions between the rows and windows over the warehouse; it ends at the restaurant and its meatball counter, then the stairs down to the market hall of shelves, bargain bins and stacks of goods. The Warehouse team holds the self-serve warehouse: four tall pallet racks with decks at 3, 6 and 9 m (rolling stairs and end ladders), forklift aisles with go-karts, the loading dock. Out through the checkouts to the car park, with trolleys, cars and a buggy. King of the Hill: the restaurant, the rack tops, the market hall.
